reply: Nobody's said that in a long time.

lines: I made the brown water. Want some?

choices.label: Only if you sit with me while I drink it.

lines: Out there, when it's bad, I listen for your voice.
Is that weird?

choices.label: I listen for yours too. More than I should.
reply: I'm going to think about that all night.
choices.memory: you said you listen for my voice

lines: Your hands are freezing. Here.
({he:name} takes your hands in {his:name} and rubs them warm)

choices.label: Don't let go yet.
choices.memory: you didn't want me to let go of your hands

choices.label: Thanks. The radio room's always cold.

lines: You laughed at something I said yesterday. Really laughed.
I've been trying to do it again since.

choices.label: Keep trying. I like it when you try.
You're funnier than you think.
reply: Write that down. I want proof.

lines: Is that my shirt you're wearing?

choices.label: It smells like you. I like it.
choices.memory: you kept my shirt

choices.label: It was on the pile. Sorry.

lines: Can't sleep either?

choices.label: Not when you're out there. Now you're here.
reply: Then neither of us is sleeping. Sit.

choices.label: Nope. Want to listen to the radio?

lines: You keep looking at my scar.

choices.label: I was thinking I'd like to know the story. And you.
reply: ...That's a long story. Stay and I'll tell it.

choices.label: It's a good scar.
reply: It's a stupid scar. Thanks, though.

lines: I brought you something. Don't make it weird.
(a wildflower, pressed flat in a notebook)

choices.label: It's not weird. It's lovely. Like you.
reply: ...You can't say things like that and expect me to stay calm.
choices.memory: the flower I pressed for you

choices.label: Thank you. Really.
reply: It made me think of you. That's all.

choices.label: Where did you even find a flower?

lines: Mind if I sit here? The bunks are too loud.
I had a dream about you.
Don't ask what kind.

choices.label: Now I really have to ask.

lines: Cut my hair. With the workshop scissors. Be honest.

choices.label: It's good. You look really good.

lines: When I got back today, the first thing I looked for was you.
Just so you know.

choices.label: I was waiting at the hatch. Just so you know.
I was on the radio the whole time.

lines: We keep ending up like this. Too close for no reason.
The music room's empty. The radio's playing a tango.
Do you dance?

choices.label: Badly. Teach me.
reply: Hand here. The other one here.
choices.memory: we danced to the tango station

lines: Everyone's watching us, you know. They've started a betting pool.

choices.label: What are the odds?
reply: Terrible. For them. I've got money on us.

lines: You did this bandage? It's perfect. Your hands are steady.
Do it again. The other arm. It's fine, I just want you to.

choices.label: Give me the arm.
reply: ...Done. You can let go now. Or not.

lines: Can I tell you something? Come here. Closer.
({he:name} stops an inch from your face)
...Never mind. Not yet.

choices.label: Not yet. But soon.
choices.memory: we almost kissed by the radio

lines: Help me with something in storage? It's heavy.
(it isn't heavy)

choices.label: Lead the way.
reply: (the door closes behind you. {he:name} doesn't turn on the light)
(a long while later you both come out with nothing)
choices.memory: the storage room, with the light off

lines: I can't keep pretending. I'm in love with you.
You can say no. I just couldn't carry it anymore.

choices.label: I love you too.
reply: ({he:name} laughs, and cries a little, and then kisses you)
choices.memory: the night I told you, and you said it back

choices.label: Let's not rush. But I feel it too.
reply: Not rushing. Ok. I can wait.

choices.label: I don't feel the same.
reply: Ok. Thank you for being honest.

lines: I wrote this down so I wouldn't stop halfway.
({he:name} reads from a crumpled page)
"You're the first thing I think about and the last. I want to be yours."

choices.label: Take my hand. I'm yours too.
reply: ({he:name} folds the paper very small and puts it in your pocket)
choices.memory: the note I read you

choices.label: I can't.
reply: ...I knew. I just had to try.

lines: I'm done waiting. Kiss me or tell me to stop.

choices.label: (kiss {him:name})
reply: ({he:name} grabs your collar and doesn't let go for a long time)
choices.memory: the first kiss, by the generator

lines: You look like you want to say something.

choices.label: I'm in love with you.
reply: Say it again. Slower. I want to remember exactly how it sounded.
choices.memory: you said you loved me

lines: Morning. You stole the blanket again.

choices.label: Come back and steal it back.
reply: ...We're going to be late for everything.

lines: When this is over, where do we go? You and me.

choices.label: Somewhere with a sea. And a door that locks.
reply: A sea and a lock. Deal.
I'm holding you to the lock.
choices.memory: the sea and the door that locks

choices.label: Wherever you are.
reply: That's a terrible plan. I love it.

lines: Long trip. Everything hurts.

choices.label: Lie down. I'll take care of it.
reply: (your hands find every knot in {his:name} back)

lines: Everyone's asleep.
({he:name} says it like a question)

choices.label: Then let's not waste it.
reply: ({he:name} pulls you toward the storage room, laughing under {his:name} breath)
(the rest of the night isn't anyone's business)
choices.memory: nights in the storage room

choices.label: Stay with me by the radio.
reply: ({he:name} curls up against you under the blanket. the static sounds like rain)

lines: What happens to us if I don't come back one day?

choices.label: You come back. Every time. That's the deal.
Then I'll never stop listening for you.
reply: ({he:name} holds you very tightly and doesn't say anything for a long time)
choices.memory: you said you'd never stop listening for me

lines: Tell me something nobody else knows about you.

choices.label: I was scared of the dark until the Silence. Now I'm scared of the quiet.
reply: ...Then I'll talk. All night if I have to.

choices.label: I talk to you on the radio even when the channel's closed.
reply: ...That's the most romantic thing I've ever heard. And creepy.

choices.label: I'll tell you when we're old.

lines: I found a tub. A real one. In the back of the generator room. It holds hot water.

choices.label: Room for two?
choices.memory: the tub in the generator room

choices.label: You first. You need it.
reply: You're sweet. Come scrub my back anyway.

lines: Can I call you something? Not "operator". Something only I say.

choices.label: Anything you want.
reply: Then you're mine. That's the word. Mine.
choices.memory: the name only I call you

lines: You sent me there knowing what it was. I know why. It still hurt.

choices.label: I'm sorry. I hate doing it to you.
reply: ...I know. That's the only reason I'm still in your bed.

choices.label: I'd send you again if it saves us.
reply: I know. I hate that I love that about you.

choices.label: You agreed to go.
reply: I'd agree to anything you asked. That's the problem.

lines: Come here. No, here. Sit.
({he:name} climbs into your lap like it's the most normal thing in the world)

choices.label: Comfortable?
reply: Very. Now hush, I'm listening to your heart.

lines: I missed you today. Out there, every corner, I thought: you'd like this view.

choices.label: Tell me about every corner.
reply: ({he:name} does. you don't remember a word, just the way {he:name} says it)

lines: My bunk's cold. Yours is warmer.
That's the only reason. Obviously.

choices.label: Obviously. Get in.
reply: ({he:name} fits against you like {he:name} was made for it)

choices.label: Just to sleep.
reply: ({he:name} falls asleep with {his:name} nose against your neck)

lines: You talk to everyone on that radio in the same voice you use with me.
I hate it. A little.

choices.label: It's my job.
reply: I know. Doesn't mean I like it.

lines: I wrote you a letter. In case. Don't read it unless.
You know. Unless.

choices.label: I'll keep it closed forever.
choices.memory: the letter I wrote for you, in case

choices.label: Let me read it now.
reply: No. It's for later. It's very embarrassing.

lines: I'll keep you company on night watch.
I brought the blanket. And not much else on under it.

choices.label: The radio can wait.
reply: (the radio waits. the static plays to an empty chair for a long time)
choices.memory: the night the radio waited

choices.label: Behave. Someone's out there tonight.
reply: ({he:name} falls asleep on your shoulder, blanket and all)

lines: I don't believe in forever anymore. Not since the Silence.
But with you I want to.

choices.label: Then let's try forever.
reply: ({he:name} kisses you like it's a promise)
choices.memory: we decided to try forever

choices.label: Let's start with tomorrow.
reply: Tomorrow, then. And the day after.

lines: You've been distant. Days. I don't even know if we're still... us.

choices.label: We're us. I'm sorry. Come here.
reply: ({he:name} lets you hold {him:name}, stiffly at first)

choices.label: I've been busy keeping everyone alive.
reply: I'm part of everyone. Remember that.

lines: I watched you laugh with the others today. You used to laugh like that with me.

choices.label: Then let's laugh. Tell me something stupid.
I still do. I've just been tired.
I can laugh with whoever I want.

lines: I saw you with {other} last night.
I'm not stupid. I just thought I was enough.

choices.label: You're not less to me. It's not like that.

lines: Never mind. It's nothing.
({he:name} looks at {other} across the room, and then away)

choices.label: It's not nothing. Talk to me.
Want to go somewhere just us?
reply: Yes. Now. Before I change my mind.

lines: I can't do this. Me or {other}. Choose.
I mean it. I'm not sharing you anymore.

choices.label: You. Only you.
reply: ({he:name} doesn't let go of you for the rest of the night)
choices.memory: you chose me

lines: {other} and I had words. Loud ones.
Don't ask me to apologize.

choices.label: I'm not asking. I'm sorry I put you there.
Both of you need to grow up.

lines: Me and {other} talked. About you.
We're fine with it. Weirdly. Don't make us regret it.

choices.label: I won't. Thank you.
reply: Don't thank me. Just don't forget whose night it is.

lines: So. You and {other}, huh?
Don't look at me like that. The walls are thin.

choices.label: Mind your own business.
reply: Fine. But I'm happy for you. Annoyingly.

lines: Be careful with {other}. Not because of {him:other}. Because of out there.
If something happens, you'll still have to send the rest of us.

choices.label: I know. I think about it every day.

lines: You and {other}... it's sweet.
I sometimes thought... never mind. Forget it.

choices.label: Thought what?
reply: ...That it might've been me. Stupid. Forget it.

lines: You've got that face. The serious one.

choices.label: I think we should stop. Us. I'm sorry.
reply: I'll move my things back to my bunk.

lines: I still keep your note. Is that pathetic?

choices.label: I still think about us.
reply: ...Don't say that unless you mean it.

choices.label: We ended it for a reason.
reply: I know. I'll throw it out.

lines: Are we really doing this again? You and me?

choices.label: If you'll have me.
choices.memory: the second time we chose each other

choices.label: Not yet.
reply: Then stop looking at me like that.

lines: You loved {dead}. Everyone knew.
You don't have to be the operator for a minute. Just sit.

choices.label: I keep hearing {his:dead} voice on the static.
reply: ({he:name} sits with you until the shift changes)
choices.memory: I sat with you after {dead} died

lines: I folded {dead}'s things. I left {his:dead} shirt on your chair.
I thought you'd want it.

choices.label: Thank you. I'll keep it.
reply: Keep it close. It still smells like {him:dead}.
choices.memory: {dead}'s shirt on your chair

choices.label: I can't look at it.
reply: I'll put it away. It's there when you can.

choices.label: Throw it out.
reply: ...No. I'll keep it for you. For later.

lines: Everyone's asking why I keep smiling at the radio.
I told them it's the static. It's you.

choices.label: Smile at me some more, then.

lines: I don't do this. People. Closeness.
But I keep coming to the radio room when you're alone.

choices.label: Keep coming. I like the quiet with you.
reply: ...Quiet with you. Yeah. That's it exactly.

lines: Why are you being nice to me? What do you want?

choices.label: Nothing. I just like you. A lot.

lines: You make me so angry sometimes I want to scream.
And then you look at me like that and I forget why.

choices.label: Like this?
reply: Exactly like that. Stop it. Don't stop.

lines: I've decided something. We're going to have a picnic. Up top. On a good day.
You and me. That's the whole plan.

choices.label: It's a date.
reply: A DATE. You said date. I heard it.
choices.memory: our picnic, someday, up top

choices.label: Up top's dangerous.
reply: So's being down here without picnics.

lines: When you talk me through it out there, I'm not scared.
It's only your voice. I don't know what that means.

choices.label: It means I'm right here. Always.
It means you're braver than you think.
It means you're doing your job.

lines: I'd follow you anywhere. I think you know that.
I think you know why.

choices.label: I know why. I feel it too.
I'd never ask you to go anywhere I wouldn't.
reply: You can't go anywhere. You're down here.

lines: I've been studying you. Your habits. What makes you laugh.
For science. Purely.

choices.label: Study me up close, then.
reply: ({he:name} doesn't study anything for a while)

lines: You never let anyone take care of you. Let me. Just tonight.

choices.label: Just tonight.
reply: ({he:name} washes your hair with warm water from the kettle. you almost fall asleep)
choices.memory: the night I took care of you

lines: Dare: kiss me before the next transmission comes in.
Thirty seconds. Go.

choices.label: (kiss {him:name})
reply: (the transmission comes in. nobody answers it for a while)
choices.memory: the dare, before the transmission

lines: I'm not going to say it first. So you'll have to.

choices.label: Fine. I like you. A lot.

lines: I don't get flustered. Ever.
So why can't I look at you right now?
You need a shave. Come here, I'll do it. Hold still.

choices.label: I trust you with a blade at my throat.
reply: (very slowly, very carefully, and then {he:name} kisses your clean jaw)

choices.label: Keep the beard. It's warm.
reply: It's scratchy. I'll get used to it.

lines: Your hair's a mess. Sit. I'll braid it.

choices.label: Take your time.
reply: ({he:name} does. {his:name} fingers linger at the back of your neck)

choices.label: It's fine messy.
reply: It's lovely messy. Let me anyway.

lines: Has anyone told you you're {handsome:op}? Before, I mean. Before all this.

choices.label: Not like you just did.
reply: ...Then they were idiots. All of them.

lines: (you wake up with {name} watching you)
Sorry. You were talking in your sleep. My name, mostly.

choices.label: Only mostly?
reply: Mostly. The rest was about batteries. Romantic.

lines: Kiss me slow. Like we have time.
Pretend we have time.

choices.label: We have time.
choices.memory: the slow kiss, pretending we had time

lines: I like your hands. On me. Just your hands.
(it's not a question)

choices.label: Lie back.
reply: (you learn {him:name} slowly, by touch, in the dark of the storage room)

choices.label: Later. I promise.
reply: I'm holding you to it. Literally.

choices.label: I'm on shift.
reply: Your shift ends at six. I'll be counting.

lines: The shower works for exactly four minutes before it runs cold.
That's enough for two. If we're quick. Or not quick.

choices.label: Not quick.
reply: (it runs cold. nobody notices for a while)
choices.memory: the cold shower nobody noticed

lines: I'm angry with you and I don't even know why. Hold me anyway.

choices.label: Tell me why first.
reply: Because you're out there in my head all day and I can't do anything!

lines: (later. {name}'s head on your chest, tracing circles on your skin)
Can I ask you something? Do you ever regret this? Us?

choices.label: Never.
choices.memory: you said never

choices.label: Only that it took so long.

lines: The tango station's on. Everyone's asleep. Dance with me?

choices.label: (take {his:name} hand)
reply: (the radio plays. the dial glows. for one song, there's no Silence at all)
choices.memory: our dance to the tango station

lines: I made you something. Don't laugh.
(a ring, bent from a copper wire, a little crooked)

choices.label: (put it on)
reply: ({he:name} is crying and pretending not to)
choices.memory: the copper ring

choices.label: You shouldn't have wasted the copper.
reply: ...I'll take it back to the workshop.

lines: Can't sleep with that racket up there.
Talk to me a bit? About anything.

choices.label: Tell me about the worst storm you remember.
reply: Okay. So. There was this one summer...
...and the dog was on the roof. Don't laugh. It's true.
choices.memory: the storm we sat through, talking

choices.label: Count between the flash and the thunder. It's moving off.
reply: Seven. Eight. Nine. ...You're right. It is.

lines: You think there's anyone out in this?
All the people we haven't found yet. Out in this.

choices.label: We'll go looking when it clears.
They've lasted this long. They know how.

lines: There's a leak over my bunk. Plink. Plink. Plink.
It's driving me out of my mind.

choices.label: Swap bunks with me tonight.
reply: You'd do that? ...You're weird. Thank you.

choices.label: Put a can under it.
reply: Now it's a plonk. Better? Not really.

lines: Smell that? Rain on concrete. Smells like before.

choices.label: Down here it smells like mould.

lines: I looked through the periscope. Thought someone was standing out there in the fog.
It's a post. It's probably a post.

choices.label: I'll look too.
reply: ...It's a post. Okay. Thanks for checking. Really.

choices.label: Fog plays tricks. Don't stare at it.

lines: Come up top with me. Just for a minute.
The sky's all out tonight.

choices.label: Five minutes. Then back down.
choices.memory: the night we went up top to see the stars

choices.label: Too risky. Stay inside.
reply: Yeah. Yeah, you're right. Maybe next time.

lines: You're up too? It's the quiet. Too much of it.

choices.label: Keep me company on the radio shift.
reply: Deal. I'll make the brown water.

lines: Sun's out. Can I take the next run? I want to feel it on my face.

choices.label: The sun looks the same from in here.

lines: Grey days get into my head. Everything feels further away.

choices.label: Help me sort the stores. Keeps the hands busy.
Tell me what's on your mind.

lines: If I could have one thing back from before, you know what it'd be?
Silly thing: {favorite}. Out of everything, that.

choices.label: Not stupid at all. I'll keep an eye out.
choices.memory: telling you about the {favorite}

lines: I made you something. It's mostly hot water. Drink it anyway.

choices.label: Best thing I've had all week.

lines: Kept this back for you. Found it on my last run. Didn't tell anyone.
Same time tomorrow? I like that we have a time.
If I don't come back one day, don't make it about you, okay?
It'll be about the road. Not about you.

choices.label: I'd still make it about me.

lines: Show me the radio. Properly. In case you ever can't.

choices.label: Sit. Start with the dial.
reply: Like this? ...Like this. Okay. I've got it.

lines: I keep humming the same tune. It's yours now, I think.
I hum it when you're on the radio.

choices.label: Now I'll have it stuck in my head.

lines: When this is over I'm opening a place. A small one. You eat free for life.
Cleaned out the workshop drawers. These were at the back, under the manuals.

choices.label: Keep them for your gear.
reply: No. They're the bunker's. Take them.

lines: No reason. Just wanted to see you.

choices.label: I was hoping you'd come by.

lines: Close your eyes. Hold out your hand.
...It's a battery. I know. Romantic.

choices.label: Where did you even find this?

lines: The night of the Silence, the last train never came in.
I kept the signal green for it until morning. Sometimes I think it's still out there, waiting for a red.

choices.label: Maybe one day we go and find it.
choices.memory: the last train I kept the signal green for

choices.label: You did your job. That's enough.

lines: Here. My watch. Stopped at 23:47 that night. Never wound it since.
I want you to have it.

choices.label: I'll keep it safe.
choices.memory: the stopped watch I gave you

lines: I think it's my birthday. Maybe. I lost track of the days.

choices.label: Then it's your birthday. We're celebrating.
choices.memory: the birthday you made up for me

lines: I call you something in my head. Not telling.
...Fine. 'Nice-boss'. Happy?

choices.label: I've got one for you too.

lines: Thirty-hour shift, the day it happened. I never clocked out.
Technically I'm still on it.

choices.label: Clock out. Right now. I'll cover.
choices.memory: the shift you told me to clock out of

choices.label: We still need you on shift.

lines: My hands shake now, after. Never during. Only after.
Route 3, all the way south. Did it forty times. I could drive it blind.

choices.label: When the roads clear, we drive it together.
reply: Deal. I'll drive, you do the radio.
choices.memory: the southern route we'll drive one day

lines: On the road we all had names on the CB. You need one.
I'm calling you Lighthouse. You keep us off the rocks.

choices.label: Lighthouse. I like it.
choices.memory: the CB name I gave you

choices.label: Sounds lonely, a lighthouse.
reply: Not with all of us out here looking at it.

lines: I still take roll in my head. Every morning. Thirty-one names.

choices.label: Say them out loud. I'll listen.
choices.memory: the thirty-one names I read out loud

choices.label: That'll eat you alive.
reply: It already did. This keeps the rest.

lines: Pop quiz. What's the most important thing you've learned down here?

choices.label: That people are worth the risk.
How to make soup out of nothing.

lines: I could tell an engine was sick from a block away.
I listen to the generator the same way now. It's tired. So am I, some days.

choices.label: Rest. The generator can wait a day.

lines: Made you something. A toolbox. Your name's on it. Spelled right and everything.

choices.label: I'll treasure it.
reply: Use it. That's how you treasure a toolbox.
choices.memory: the toolbox with your name on it

choices.label: I don't know how to use half of these.

lines: My grandmother's recipe. I never wrote it down.
I'm telling you, so it isn't only in my head.

choices.label: Tell me. I'll remember.
choices.memory: my grandmother's recipe, now yours too

choices.label: Write it down instead.
reply: Writing it down isn't the same. But okay.

lines: Taste this. Honest answer.

choices.label: Honestly? Perfect.
reply: You're just saying that. ...Say it again.

choices.label: Needs salt.
reply: EVERYTHING needs salt. We have no salt!

lines: I wrote something. About down here. About you, a little.
Want to hear it?

choices.label: Play it.
reply: So? Don't answer. Your face answered.
choices.memory: the song I wrote about the bunker

lines: Hold this. Fingers here. No, here. There. That's a chord.
I mapped a way across the neighbourhood using only rooftops.
Nobody else knows it. Now you do.

choices.label: Our secret.
choices.memory: the rooftop route only we know

choices.label: Use it. It'll keep you safe.

lines: You asked once what I write in the notebook. Here. Page one.
It's a list of everyone I've lost. And on the last page, everyone I haven't. You're on it.

choices.label: Keep that page safe.
reply: It's the one I keep safest.
choices.memory: the last page of my notebook

choices.label: Can I write on it too?
